biggest_catch: Camplify takes commission (from 7% AU / 10% UK depending on membership); earnings are variable with no guaranteed income.
catches: Free to join and list; commission from 7% (Australia, Premium) or 10% (UK) on bookings - no upfront costs
Owners set their own nightly price, availability, and rules; Camplify claims up to $40,000/yr (AU) / £10,000/yr (UK) for active owners (provider marketing claims, not guaranteed)
All hirers verified with licence and ID checks; damage protection and insurance options included
Vehicle must be registered with current registration; owner approves every booking
